QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Suspicious Energy
QuestInfo.0: It isn't far to the second seal. There's no time to waste.
QuestInfo.1: It isn't far to the second seal. There's no time to waste.
QuestInfo.2: Near the second seal, you found the Primacy, a militia who operates in Grandis. They wanted to negotiate with you, and Hawkeye managed to strike a deal. However, the Primacy doesn't seem all too friendly. Will you really be able to work with them like Seren thought you would?
